projects.title: Zava DIY Enterprise Multi-Agent AI System (COMPSCI 714 — Team 5)
projects.summary: Cloud-native B2B & B2C multi-agent AI architecture deployed on Microsoft Azure using Model Context Protocol (MCP), Azure OpenAI hybrid model tiering, and PostgreSQL with pgvector & Row-Level Security.
highlights: Designed a hybrid two-tier LLM pipeline pairing gpt-4.1-mini (fast MCP tool calling & dynamic SQL generation) with gpt-5-mini (chain-of-thought executive risk synthesis), reducing single-query latency from ~19.7s to ~7.5s (~62% faster) while eliminating unnecessary hidden reasoning tokens.

Built dual containerized apps on Azure App Service & ACR: a B2B Enterprise AI Analyst (Streamlit) querying 50,000+ retail records via sandboxed read-only MCP servers (sales_analysis, customer_sales, enterprise_intel) and a B2C 4-Specialist Multi-Agent DIY Advisor (FastAPI + real-time SSE streaming).
Implemented semantic catalog search using pgvector (1536-d text-embedding-3-small) inside Azure PostgreSQL 17 with Row-Level Security (RLS) for store-level tenant isolation.

Enforced keyless zero-trust authentication via Azure Managed Identity (DefaultAzureCredential) and reproducible Infrastructure as Code via Azure Bicep, plus system-level prompt guardrails against off-topic abuse.

projects.title: Interactive AI Resume Assistant (Ruby) — Live Portfolio App
projects.summary: Zero-build interactive resume assistant hosted on GitHub Pages, backed by a Cloudflare Workers Gemini 2.5 Flash proxy, Edge KV Response Cache, and automatic local BM25 RAG fallback.
highlights: Decoupled all resume content into a single structured JSON knowledge base with browser-native ES modules, client-side BM25 search, XSS-safe Markdown rendering, and a dynamic Resume Quick-View drawer.

Deployed a Cloudflare Worker proxy keeping GEMINI_API_KEY private with strict Origin enforcement, structured JSON follow-up generation, thinkingBudget=0 latency optimization, and automatic 429 cooldown fallback to local resume.json retrieval.

Implemented a Cloudflare Workers KV Edge Response Cache keyed by an automatic FNV-1a content hash of resume.json + normalized query, cutting repeated query latency from ~2,000ms to ~70ms (~28x faster) with zero LLM tokens and automatic cache invalidation on resume edits.

notes: In progress — postgraduate study in AI architecture, multi-agent systems, and applied machine learning alongside senior software engineering work.
Specialized in Accounting, providing strong understanding of financial reporting, business operations, and domain logic for fintech systems.

narrative.title: Why Hsiang Is Studying Artificial Intelligence
narrative.summary: Hsiang views AI as a generational inflection point comparable to the dawn of personal computing — a foundational shift that will inevitably reshape every industry and workflow.
details: She sees today's AI transition as comparable to when computers were first introduced to the world: it is not a temporary trend, and organizations and engineers will inevitably need to build with it.

Rather than remaining a passive consumer of AI tools, she enrolled in the Master of Artificial Intelligence at the University of Auckland to build rigorous theoretical foundations alongside her 8+ years of production software engineering.
She pairs formal study with hands-on systems engineering — building cloud-native multi-agent Azure/MCP systems (Zava DIY AI Assistant) and edge-cached LLM applications (this interactive resume app).

narrative.title: Long-Term Vision: Applying Internal AI Technology in Enterprises
narrative.summary: Long-term, Hsiang aims to help companies adopt, implement, and evolve practical internal AI technologies directly within their existing operations and software systems.
details: Her long-term goal is to apply and evolve internal AI technology tailored to each company's real operations — integrating AI smoothly into existing enterprise workflows and backend systems rather than building isolated prototypes.

Many enterprise AI initiatives stall between proof-of-concept and everyday adoption due to legacy integration, data integrity, security, and reliability challenges — the exact problems she has solved across core banking migrations and large-scale fintech systems.

Combining senior C#/.NET backend engineering, a Master of Management in Accounting, and a Master of Artificial Intelligence positions her to bridge real business goals with practical, reliable internal AI adoption.

narrative.title: Engineering & Collaboration Approach
narrative.summary: Pragmatic, quality-focused senior engineer who emphasizes maintainability, TDD, CI/CD, security boundaries, and supportive technical mentorship.
details: Believes software should align tightly with real business and financial outcomes, not just technical complexity.
Values strong engineering fundamentals — xUnit/TDD, CI/CD workflows (GitHub Actions), read-only tool sandboxing (MCP), and keyless authentication.
Enjoys mentoring teammates, untangling complex validation or legacy migration issues, and translating ambiguous stakeholder requirements into reliable deliverables.
